ai.name: AI & Automation
ai.price_note: Brandible typical one-time setup range depending on complexity, with optional monthly support. Not a national average.
includes: Discovery call to map where AI or automation will save time or catch leads
Tool selection and setup (chat, forms, email/SMS follow-up, or workflow tools)
Custom prompts, scripts, and routing rules
ai.distinguish: Missed-call texts, form auto-replies, and reminder sequences are automation. A chat that answers common questions can be AI. Do not call ordinary automation AI.
ai.summary: Practical after-hours catch and follow-up. Not a science project.
